apps.name: Sound2U
apps.description: Wereldwijde radio, podcasts, lokale audio en nieuwsbulletins met slimme ontdekking, vertaling en Talk2Me.
apps.changelog: Sound2U 0.3.53 - "Continue listening" now displays only the most recently played media item. - Radio and podcasts now share a single "Continue listening" tile. - Playing something else automatically replaces the previous item. - The tile thus always reflects the latest item from the media player. - Various minor stability improvements.

apps.name: VatRadar
apps.description: Live VATSIM-radar met vluchten, ATC, vliegvelden, routes en vliegtuigfoto's.
apps.changelog: VAT24 1.0.3 - Added ATC along your planned SimBrief route. - Added Recently viewed flights to Search. - Airports and airlines can now be favourited directly from relevant screens. - ATC airport and traffic chips now open the corresponding airport or flight. - Nearby aircraft in flight details can now be opened directly. - Smarter live-data refresh for improved battery efficiency. - Background notification polling now runs only when actually required. - Notification permissions are requested only when a notification feature is enabled. - Various navigation, battery and usability improvements.

apps.name: Esmarty
apps.description: Material You app voor het vinden en vergelijken van lokale prepaid-eSIMs.
apps.changelog: Esmarty changelog v0.5.4 - Provider links now open in Esmarty's own in-app browser by default instead of always handing the URL to Android's default browser. - Added automatic provider-page language detection and on-device translation with ML Kit. - Added website translation targets: System language, Dutch, English and Spanish. - Esmarty first prefers an official provider language variant when one is advertised by the site; otherwise it translates the visible page text. - Added Original / Translate switching plus an explicit Open in browser action. - Login, authentication, cart, checkout and payment flows are handed back to the user's normal browser. - Added an Esmarty settings dialog for in-app browser and translation preferences. - Fixed system theme handling: Esmarty now uses the dark palette when Android dark mode is enabled and the light palette otherwise. - The embedded browser follows system dark mode using WebView algorithmic darkening where supported. - Added explicit day/night system-bar styling. - Updated app version to 0.5.4 (versionCode 10).

apps.name: WeatherMe
apps.description: Material You weer-app met verwachtingen, waarschuwingen, radar en weerdetails.
apps.changelog: WeatherMe 2.4.3 Warnings and background notifications - Official warnings now have their own WorkManager task of approximately 15 minutes and are no longer linked to the widget refresh. - The warning worker only runs when notifications are enabled, Android has notification permission, a saved location exists, and a supported official source is available for that location. - Warnings are cached locally. As a result, a warning that has already been retrieved in the background appears immediately in the app upon opening. - The app checks warnings during a normal foreground refresh parallel to the base forecast; the current temperature/forecast therefore remains quickly visible. - Expired or disappeared warnings are cleared from the Android notification screen. A modified warning replaces the same notification instead of leaving behind a second card. - Stricter regional MeteoAlarm filtering prevents all warnings for a country from being displayed automatically in the event of a failed region match. - Official source coverage expanded to include NOAA/NWS (US/Puerto Rico), Environment and Climate Change Canada, and the public state warning feeds from the Australian Bureau of Meteorology, in addition to KNMI and MeteoAlarm. - For countries without a stable public official source, WeatherMe explicitly reports this; no useless official warning worker is scheduled there. Global rain reports remain a separate forecast function. Stability and Battery - Background widget work is only scheduled when a WeatherMe widget is actually present. - Widget, official warning, and rain workers re-check whether the saved location is still the same before saving/reporting. As a result, a late response from an old location cannot overwrite a new location. - WorkManager retries use a battery-friendly exponential back-off instead of rapid repeated retries in the event of temporary network issues. - Global rain monitoring now uses only one Open-Meteo request; the former second full fallback request in the event of an error has been removed. - Rainwork is rescheduled after the first successful location determination, ensuring that enabling it before the first location is not limited to a one-time check. - When Android notification permission is missing or denied, official warning and rain polling are not performed periodically. Schedules are realigned upon a change in permission. - MapLibre is only initialized when the map is actually opened, not upon a background-only WorkManager process start. - Application.onCreate() has been deliberately kept light; notification channels are created using the lazy method, and periodic work is persisted by WorkManager itself. - WeatherCache contains location metadata and uses atomic writing; as a result, widget and home screen cache remain consistent during location changes and process interruptions. - Foreground refreshes have generation guards to ensure that late results from an older manual refresh do not overwrite a newer location/snapshot.

apps.name: SkyRadar
apps.description: Live aircraft spotting met vliegtuigfoto's, kaart, slimme meldingen en uitgebreide spotterfuncties.
apps.changelog:
SkyRadar 1.0.0-alpha13.0

- Completely redesigned Material 3 interface.
- Nearby aircraft is now the default home screen.
- Aircraft cards show photos, distance, altitude, speed, registration and aircraft type.
- Tap an aircraft to open and select it directly on the live map.
- Added smart proximity notifications.
- Filter notifications by radius, airline and aircraft type.
- Added maximum altitude filters.
- Added favorite aircraft registrations and alerts.
- Added special aircraft filtering for aircraft such as the A380, Boeing 747, Antonov and military traffic.
- Added likely-overflight detection using distance, altitude, speed and heading.
- Added Spotter section with Favorites and Today.
- Today records nearby aircraft including minimum distance and time of passage.
- Improved aircraft photo matching and caching.
- Improved location updates, navigation and overall stability.

apps.name: Customer Nearby
apps.description: Wereldwijde klantenservicezoeker met telefoon, WhatsApp, e-mail, websites en storingsinformatie.
apps.changelog: Customer Nearby 0.2.13 - Added direct curated Netherlands customer-service call actions for DELTA (0118 22 55 75), Ziggo (0900 1884) and Odido (0800 0092), while retaining existing KPN/Vodafone/Guidion profiles. - Added Odido's international service number and normalized current first-party support routes for Ziggo and Odido. - Booking.com NL now shows a descriptive Bericht of bel 24/7 action that opens Booking.com's official localized support flow instead of inventing a fixed phone number. - Contact-cache schema bumped to 7 so older sparse cached profiles cannot hide new curated contact actions. - Split outage routing into a user-facing preferred status URL and a separate regional automatic-detection URL. - KPN, Ziggo, Odido and DELTA now open verified first-party status/service checkers from the outage UI where available. - Added DELTA to the Netherlands outage catalogue. - Added a 30-minute per-country automatic backoff after regional outage-source 403/429 responses, preventing repeated Home/company-open retries against a temporarily blocked source. - Manual outage refresh may still explicitly retry; failed/unparseable checks remain UNKNOWN and never become false outage cards. - Added Dutch/English/Spanish strings for the new official-status and Booking.com contact UI. - Version bumped to 0.2.13 / versionCode 17.
